data.name: Manazir
data.gender_notes: Manazir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Arabic language, Manazir refers to the constellation Orion, which was believed to represent the warrior-king Jabalah. The name also signifies a well-arranged or planned system. The name Manazir carries the meaning “Constellation, Arrangement, Plan” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manazir usually hope their child will grow to embody constellation, arrangement, plan and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and protection, Manazir is a name deeply rooted in the celestial world.
data.etymology: Manazir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Constellation, Arrangement, Plan.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manazir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مناظر
in_arabic.meaning: مناظر هي اسم يعني المراقب والمشاهد للمناظر الطبيعية
in_arabic.long_meaning: مناظر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني المراقب والمشاهد للمناظر الطبيعية، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام آية ٧٣ 'وَهُوَ الَذِي يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَماعَةً وَيُنَزِلُ الْمَثَانيَ مِنَ السَّماءِ بِقَدَرٍ ثُمَّ يَقْضِي أَمْرًا وَأَمْرًا وَهُوَ الَذِي يَجْعَلُكُمُ الْعَزائِرَ فِي الْأَرْضِ هَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ مُلْكٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ'، وقد ذكر بعض المفسرين أن مناظر يمكن أن يكون مشتقًا من النظر والمراقبة.

in_urdu.name: مناظر
in_urdu.meaning: مناظر کا مطلب ہے مراقب، مشاہدہ کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مناظر ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے مراقب، مشاہدہ کرنے والا۔ اردو میں اس کا استعمال مذکر اسم کے طور پر ہوتا ہے۔ مناظر نام ذاتی خوبیوں جیسے مراقبہ، صبر اور غور و خوض کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मनाज़िर
in_hindi.meaning: मनाज़िर का अर्थ है प्रेक्षक, देखने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मनाज़िर एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से उत्पन्न हुआ है। इसका अर्थ है प्रेक्षक, देखने वाला। यह नाम उन गुणों का प्रतीक है जैसे कि ध्यान, धैर्य और विचारशीलता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी विशिष्ट अर्थ और महत्व के कारण पसंद किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مناظر
in_pashto.meaning: مناظر د لیدونکي او څارنکي معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: مناظر یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د لیدونکي او څارنکي معنی لري. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د مراقبت، صبر او غور او خوض د ځانګړتیاوو نښه ده.

in_english.name: Manazir
in_english.meaning: Manazir means observer, one who watches or gazes
in_english.long_meaning: Manazir is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It means observer, one who watches or gazes. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic root 'n-z-r' which conveys the sense of looking or observing. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies qualities like contemplation, patience, and introspection. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual vigilance and mindfulness.

data.cultural_impact: Manazir is a name of Arabic origin, and its association with the constellation Orion has deep cultural significance. The Arab world has a rich heritage in astronomy, and the study of stars and their patterns has long been a source of inspiration and knowledge. The constellation Orion, with its distinctive shape of three stars in a straight line, is particularly significant. In Arabic literature and folklore, it was often described as the back of a giant hunter named Orion, who was pursued by the scorpion Scorpius and finally killed by the goddess Isis. The reference to Manazir as the constellation Orion highlights this cultural connection.
